title: Monitoring SARS-CoV-2 Nsp13 helicase binding activity using expanded genetic code techniques
content:

Eryn Lundrigan, Christine Hum, Nadine Ahmed, John Paul Pezacki
The severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) non-structural protein 13 (Nsp13) helicase is a multi-functional protein that can unwind dsDNA and dsRNA in an NTP-dependent manner.
